sentences.en: Most of the ranchers are barely getting along as it is.

sentences.en: So far I don't think I have a problem, but I have to consider those other ranchers when I decide how many wolves this land can support.

sentences.en: Ranchers often use manganese in the mineral supplements they give to farm animals.

sentences.en: Within the United States, cattle ranchers are restoring the prairies destroyed by overgrazing with the help of the cattle themselves.

sentences.en: Now, a two-year drought that has left creeks dry and forced ranchers to sell livestock is increasing the ecological damage.
